Building AI Agents with Skills vs without Skills

Everyone’s building AI agents

Almost no one knows which orchestration framework to use 

Here’s how to stop winging it :

⭕️ Use n8n when:

 • You’re integrating LLMs with tools
 • Your flow is trigger → AI → action
 • You want fast, no-code deployment
 • You don’t need agent memory

 ⭕️ Use LangGraph when:

 • Your agents need to think, loop, reflect
 • You want memory + state across steps
 • You’re building logic trees, retries, branching 
  paths
 • You need observability

This 15-minute AI agent workflow can help run parts of your business for you:

(even if you are non-technical)

1. Open ChatGPT.

2. Create a Project called “My AI Assistant.”

3. Upload:
 your FAQs
  services/products
  SOPs
  brand voice notes
  pricing sheet
  sales scripts

4. Tell ChatGPT:
 “You are my AI operations assistant.”

5. Add instructions like:
 answer customer questions
  write emails
  draft proposals
  organize ideas
  summarize meetings
